column2: u/Diogenes_2026 saw the spellbook call Presence of Mind baseline. That line was written from the demo footage and never checked against the beta. It is still an Arcane talent, fifth row, and the spellbook says so now.
Beta build 70009: two talents gone, two renamed, two swap rows
Blizzard pushed 69893 on the evening of 16 Sep. Compared file by file with 69876: 18 client files changed and none of them hold talent, spell, racial or Legacy data.

Blizzard pushed 69977 on the evening of 22 Sep. Compared file by file with 69913: 25 client files changed, and none of the 73 tables that hold talent, spell, racial or Legacy data is among them. Two settings tables did change: the game rules table gained eight rows (the files do not name them) and three region dates shifted.

Blizzard pushed 70009 on the afternoon of 24 Sep with development notes. The first build since 69876 that changes talents and spells: two talents gone, two Druid talents renamed, two Shaman talents swapped rows, and a run of number changes. Blizzard's notes also say Bastion and Focused Rage swap rows for Protection Warriors, but this build's files still have them where they were, so the site shows them as the files have them.

Blizzard's fifth beta build landed on 24 Sep with development notes, and the site now reads its files. On the trees: Improved Holy Strike is gone from Holy Paladins, and Holy Strike's cooldown is 10 seconds for everyone now. Crusade is gone from Retribution. Mangle is called Primal Bite, and Primal Fury is Blood Frenzy again, old icon and all. Elemental Shamans get Elemental Alacrity in row 3 and Elemental Fury moves down to row 6. Numbers moved on Holy Power, Sacred Arbiter, Vengeance, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Twist of Light, Bloodthrill, Improved Slam, Rage of the Farseer, Hot Streak, Wake of Fire and Strider Kick.

In the spellbooks: Holy Strike's weapon damage climbs every rank now, 25% to 50%. Wrath does about half again as much at every rank. Lightning Bolt ranks 3 and 4 and Lava Burst are up. Slam's cooldown is 18 seconds, and Righteous Fury's threat bonus is 60%. Gnomes' Eureka! is a flat 10% discount for every class, and Touch of the Grave only fires from things that do damage and no longer breaks crowd control.

Every link and saved build from before still opens on the right talents. Points that sat on a talent that is gone come back to you. One thing the notes say that the files do not: Bastion and Focused Rage swapping rows for Protection Warriors. The site shows what the files hold, and will follow the build that carries it. In the game under What's new has the full list, class by class.

Also from the notes, for the beta only: a respec costs 1 silver once an hour has passed since your last one.

On an iPad with a trackpad the tooltip closed after a few seconds even with the cursor still on the talent. iPadOS hides an idle cursor and the page read that as leaving. It stays open now until you move off, tap or scroll. Thanks to u/jmicro89.
Second beta build

Survival's Lightning Reflexes read 3, 6, 9, 12, 15% here. In the game files and in the game itself the talent in the tree gives 2, 4, 6, 8, 10%. The 3% came from a second, retired copy of the talent that sits off the grid in the files and still answers in game, and the September in-game check matched it by name. Fixed. Thanks to the person who maintains wowforeversite.wiki for reading the export closely enough to ask.

Talents Forever runs inside the game now, free on CurseForge. The addon page walks through every screen; here is the short version.

Plan without spending. The same three trees, in the game's own window. Click a talent to plan a point, right click to take it back. Nothing goes on your character until you press Apply, or you switch on hands-free and let it place points as you level. The Plan page lists every point by level, the bar under the trees shows the build at any level, and hovering a level lights up the talents you gain by then.

Popular builds, in game. The list from this site, refreshed from the live counts. Try it rings a build's talents over your own so you see where it differs. Load makes it your plan.

Builds travel. The same link this site makes. Paste one in and it loads. Party, Guild or a whisper sends it, and anyone with the addon gets it as a card. Phone QR draws the build as a code your phone opens on the site. Saved builds stay with the character.

The trainer, and the whole road. A card when you level with something to learn, and the trainer's whole list inside the addon; prices fill in once you have visited your trainer with the addon on. The Spellbook list beside the window shows every ability to 60 at the level you learn it, with what you know already in green. The game only shows what you have and the trainer only what you can buy today.

Coach, Races, Ctrl. Three quick reads on your plan. Every race your class can be, with its racials. Hold Ctrl on a talent and the tooltip shows the spell it changes.

Off switches. Every page, the level-up card, other people's builds, the minimap book, the character-pane tab. Hands-free starts off.

Where it came from. Eight questions and a box on this site, for four days. About a hundred of you voted, 43 wrote in, and most of the list above started as one of those notes. The page names the ones who left a name.

It is still the beta. Say what is off from the Feedback button inside the addon, or on the page, and it gets read.
